Fatigue may creep in faster than usual; immunity dips slightly, raising susceptibility to colds or minor inflammation. Rest isn’t optional—it’s strategic. Skip late-night scrolling or heavy meals—your body craves stillness.

### Final Verdict: A Day of Wise Restraint  
Today’s overall energy is *challenging*, not catastrophic—but respect matters. Your best move? Choose stillness over speed, review over rush, and listening over leading. Consult trusted friends before acting—especially on big decisions. Remember: the Ox’s greatest strength isn’t brute force, but enduring wisdom. And wisdom, today, wears the quiet cloak of caution.
